setting.cleanup.title: Data Cleanup
setting.cleanup.description: Review and clear each type of data separately. Thumbnails and media metadata are managed together. Original photos and videos are preserved.
setting.cleanup.library_description: Clear thumbnails, the photo index and local metadata such as favorites, and rebuild sync history. Original files, signed-in accounts and sync configuration are preserved. The app restarts and scans again.
setting.cleanup.logs_description: Clear the current log, compressed archives and crash reports. New logs continue to be recorded. Signed-in accounts are preserved.
setting.cleanup.accounts_description: Sign out of all local sync accounts. Delete their tokens from the system keyring, database account records, sync configuration and staging cache. The photo index, thumbnails and originals are preserved. The app restarts; sign in again to reconnect.
setting.cleanup.all_description: Clear all of the above, including logs, thumbnails, media metadata, login tokens and database account records. Original files and preferences are preserved. The app restarts; sign in again to reconnect.
setting.logs.level_description: Applies immediately to both log files and terminal output.
setting.logs.limit_description: Up to 500 MB. Old archives are removed first; the current run retains its most recent logs.
